theorems.name: Submission.fiw_localization
theorems.statement: SlicingTheorem → BoundaryRectifiability → ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)), IsOpen U → ∀ (T : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)) (Tj : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)), IsIntegerMultiplicity T → (∀ j, IsIntegerMultiplicity (Tj j)) → (∀ W, CompactlyContainedOpen W U → (⨆ j, ((Tj j).massOn W + (Tj j).boundary.massOn W)) < ∞) → WeaklyConvergesOn Tj T → ∀ W, CompactlyContainedOpen W U → ∃ (ψ : ℕ → ℕ) (K : Set (Eucl P)) (B : ℝ≥0∞) (T' : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)) (T'j : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)), StrictMono ψ ∧ IsCompact K ∧ K ⊆ U ∧ B ≠ ∞ ∧ (∀ j, IsIntegerMultiplicity (T'j j)) ∧ (∀ j, IsIntegerMultiplicity (T'j j).boundary) ∧ (∀ j, (T'j j).support ⊆ K) ∧ (∀ j, (T'j j).mass + (T'j j).boundary.mass ≤ B) ∧ WeaklyConvergesOn T'j T' ∧ ∀ (j : ℕ) (R : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1 + 1)) (S : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)), IsIntegerMultiplicity R → IsIntegerMultiplicity S → (∀ ω, T'j j ω - T' ω = R.boundary ω + S ω) → flatDistance W (Tj (ψ j)) T ≤ S.massOn W + R.massOn W
